findings.observed: Weak helper accepts non-midnight 24h support and silently collapses duplicate daily products; order can change event probability. Strict helper rejects. Boolean/NaN validation also differs.
findings.historical_impact: Not established; production builders may supply only valid inputs. No claim of an exploit bypassing FormalSession or corrupted published scores.
findings.exit_gate: Shared versioned contract validation, independent arithmetic cross-checks, actual checkout entry tests and read-only scan of frozen temperature inputs.

findings.observed: STOP or expiration after claim during key-read does not prevent subsequent HTTP open. Pre-claim controls reject correctly.
findings.contract_qualification: If deadline means claim eligibility only, document this explicitly; no-new-dispatch guarantee needs a final gate and a stated local linearization rule. Does not imply remote cancellation.
findings.historical_impact: No published late or stopped real request established.
findings.exit_gate: Final dispatch authorization, before/after-boundary controls, unmodified escrow and original-request identity, actual-receipt impact scan.

findings.observed: A 401-digit JSON integer raises OverflowError at math.isfinite instead of a uniform invalid probability error.
findings.historical_impact: Not established. Normal invalid outputs already reject. Caller integration must preserve failed opportunities and cost.
findings.exit_gate: Safe ordered validation, actual caller invalid/fallback regression, no clipping or model retry.
